svg.title: Kunal Siyag
svg.desc: A terminal types whoami and prints KUNAL SIYAG in block letters, then: I build things that move, break, or talk back. A Wayland recorder whose camera chases your cursor, a city run by five AI mayors, a store built to fall over on sale day. An ASCII donut spins beside it.
